message.belts.stretch_started: Stretch started. Sneak-click to add a corner, click where it ends.
message.belts.stretch_corner: Corner added. Sneak-click for another, click where the stretch ends.
message.belts.stretch_behind: A stretch runs ahead of the way you looked when you started it, never back.
message.belts.stretch_blocked: A block stands in the stretch's way.
message.belts.stretch_no_ground: A tile of this stretch has no solid ground under it.
message.belts.wedge_blocked: A slope here needs a wedge under it, and only air, plants or snow can make way for one.
message.belts.stretch_not_enough: This stretch needs %s tiles, and you have %s.
message.belts.stretch_no_room: No room in your inventory for the tiles this stretch replaces.
item.belts.chute.tooltip: Moves 15 items a second between an inventory and a belt, whatever the belt's tier.
item.belts.improved_chute.tooltip: Moves 30 items a second between an inventory and a belt, whatever the belt's tier.
item.belts.express_chute.tooltip: Moves 45 items a second between an inventory and a belt, whatever the belt's tier.
item.belts.turbo_chute.tooltip: Moves 60 items a second between an inventory and a belt, whatever the belt's tier.
block.belts.chute.tooltip.1: [Right-Click] with an item to set it as filter.
block.belts.chute.tooltip.ftbfilters: Supports smart filters from the 'FTB Filters' mod.
item.belts.belt_tile.tooltip: One block of belt, carrying 15 items a second. Belts in a line carry items as one; a line of mixed tiers runs at its slowest block. Placed running the way you look; sneak-click to start a stretch.
item.belts.improved_belt_tile.tooltip: One block of belt, carrying 30 items a second. Belts in a line carry items as one; a line of mixed tiers runs at its slowest block. Placed running the way you look; sneak-click to start a stretch.
item.belts.express_belt_tile.tooltip: One block of belt, carrying 45 items a second. Belts in a line carry items as one; a line of mixed tiers runs at its slowest block. Placed running the way you look; sneak-click to start a stretch.
item.belts.turbo_belt_tile.tooltip: One block of belt, carrying 60 items a second. Belts in a line carry items as one; a line of mixed tiers runs at its slowest block. Placed running the way you look; sneak-click to start a stretch.
